builtRasterPending.doesNotZeroOrWaive: visualDefects stays whatever it is; BUILT_RASTER_PENDING records that nobody has looked, not that there is nothing to see
builtRasterPending.meaning: packet construction is finished and the visual gate has not run

fixtureDiscovery.grantsNothing: finding a fixture queues a render. It renders nothing, proves nothing, and promotes nothing.
fixtureDiscovery.listing: recursive, and each PDF is named relative to that root, so a role carried by a variant directory name is preserved rather than discarded
fixtureDiscovery.root: the family's fixtures/ directory where it exists; otherwise, for a family that keeps none, the family directory with its fixtures located by the files its builder declares as fixtures in reports/rendered-artifacts.json
fixtureDiscovery.whyItMatters: a family whose fixtures are not found never enters the queue, never earns a RASTER_PASS and can never be PASS_COMPLETE, and the queue reads as complete while saying nothing about what it declined to enrol

grantsNothing: A RASTER_PASS proves the pages render as measured. It is one gate of several, it promotes nothing, and it opens no commercial route.
packetCommitShaIsAGenerationStampNotAByt: This field records when the queue was written, not what a raster rendered. Bind a receipt with the row's canonicalPdfSha256 and boundaryPdfSha256 and with the receipt's own renderedCommitSha. A queue regenerated after a run will carry a newer commit than the run that produced its receipts, and that is not drift.

RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL.isNotAGateReceipt: Locally produced page rasters are not the central gate.s evidence. They were made on an uncalibrated runner, under no canary and no negative controls, and no receipt binds them to the queue.s pinned hashes.
RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL.treatAs: RASTER_PENDING for every routing and promotion decision
RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL.why: A builder container that happens to resolve a real Chromium can render pages locally. PF-C did, and refused to call the result BUILT_RASTER_PENDING because pages had in fact been rastered, or RASTER_PASS because the central workflow had not run. That distinction is correct and the state is declared here so it is not unknown vocabulary.

routing.RASTER_BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT: the runner could not render at all; this is an environment defect and not a packet defect, and it never becomes RASTER_FAIL
routing.RASTER_PASS: the family goes to independent verification

coverage.basis: the family ships one assembled packet, so rendering it covers every canonical page of the family
coverage.notRenderedByThisGateBasis: every PDF present in the family's fixture discovery that this row does not queue. The gate renders every document a row queues, whatever its role, so a queued boundary fixture is rendered and is not named here.
coverage.whatCompleteMeansHere: every canonical document is rendered, and so is every other document this row queues. The 4 fixture(s) named in notRenderedByThisGate are present in the family's fixture set and are not queued here, so they are unrendered and a defect appearing only in them is not something a RASTER_PASS has excluded.

supersededReceipts.theTwoCoverageQuestions: documentsNotCovered names canonical documents this gate was asked for and did not render. whatThisGateDidNotRender names declared fixtures it never renders by design, which is normally the boundary artifact. An empty documentsNotCovered beside a populated whatThisGateDidNotRender is the ordinary, correct shape.

whatRasterPassDoesNotMean: RASTER_PASS is one gate. It does not make a family PASS_COMPLETE, does not promote it, does not open a commercial route, and does not substitute for an independent read by a worker that did not build it.
whatTheVisualGateStillProves: expected dimensions for the requested PDF-point scale
artifact hashes match the submitted PDFs
whyThisExists: The Codex container cannot resolve or fetch a Chromium (ENV-RAS01: Playwright CDN answers HTTP 403), so the visual gate is unreachable from where packets are built. The render moves to a browser-equipped GitHub runner. Nothing about PASS_COMPLETE is weakened.

workflowReachability.consequence: RASTER_PASS is obtainable: dispatch from main with the full 40-hex commit SHA of the pushed head. PASS_COMPLETE still requires a hash-bound complete-coverage receipt plus an independent read; reachability waives neither.
workflowReachability.dispatchableFrom: the repository default branch only, which is how GitHub scopes workflow_dispatch
workflowReachability.observed: origin/main carries .github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml; dispatched batches have returned receipts (e.g. run 33495068504, whose complete-coverage RASTER_PASS receipts the VF26 verdicts bind to)
workflowReachability.whatThisIsNot: This is not a defect in the gate and not a reason to relax it.
workflowReachability.whoDecides: merging workflow changes to the default branch is Roger's decision

selectionReason: Repaired PA pardon family; every current declared canonical/boundary PDF selected by existing raster queue.
